sentences.en: Students should make use of the books in the library.
sentences.zh: 学生应该利用图书馆里的书。

sentences.en: The new library has been under construction since last year.
sentences.zh: 新图书馆从去年开始就一直在建设中。

sentences.en: This is the largest dictionary there is in this library.
sentences.zh: 这是这个图书馆里最大的词典。
